subject.title: fix: active-memory recall fails with billing rejections on subscription-only Claude CLI setups

question: Should the permanent fix keep this Claude-specific embedded-run opt-in, or move helper execution to a generic capability-owned CLI dispatch seam shared with the remaining paths in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57326?
rationale: The choice determines the long-term provider ownership and MCP authorization boundary; code inspection can identify the tradeoff but cannot establish maintainer intent for the permanent core contract.

options.title: Use a generic capability seam
options.body: Move the dispatch decision behind the registered CLI backend or runtime capability so helper callers share one provider-owned path.

options.title: Approve the narrow opt-in
options.body: Keep the Claude-specific caller opt-in, document its intentionally limited scope, and leave other helper paths to the canonical follow-up issue.

recommendation.title: Use a generic capability seam
recommendation.body: Move the dispatch decision behind the registered CLI backend or runtime capability so helper callers share one provider-owned path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the recent CLI runtime aliasing and agent-routing work associated with this area.
